blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generated images often have coherent layouts and visual content, yet local errors in small text and complex characters still limit their readability and practical use. Scene-text refinement requires accuracy, preservation, and efficiency. Existing methods based on variational autoencoders (VAEs) can lose fine strokes during reconstruction, while full-image editing can shift background colors. In this work, we introduce PixText, a model that formulates local text refinement as grouped image generation in pixel space. Conditioned on the original image, PixText generates only the target regions, preserves unedited content, and uses MeanFlow for four-step generation. We further introduce Text Refinement Bench to evaluate text correction and image preservation in generated images. On this benchmark, PixText achieves 83.06% glyph pass and 94.66% exact target-character OCR accuracy, versus 36.77% and 52.31% for the strongest baseline. Its four-step MeanFlow variant retains an 81.84% pass rate with less than one GPU-second of amortized generation cost per image.
blocks.zh: 所生成的图像往往有连贯的布局和视觉内容,而小文本和复杂字符的局部错误仍然限制了其可读性和实用性. 改进场景文本需要准确、保存和效率。 以可变自编码器(VAEs)为基础的现有方法在重建期间会失去细微的中风,而全图像编辑可以改变背景颜色. 在这个作品中,我们引入了PixText,这个模型在像素空间中以分组图像生成的形式,来表达本地文本的完善. 以原始图像为条件,PixText只生成目标区域,保存未经编辑的内容,并使用MeanFlow进行四步生成. 我们还引入了 " 文本改进座椅 " ,以评估生成图像中的文本校正和图像保存情况。 在这个基准上,PixText实现了83.06%的glyph通取和94.66%的精确目标特征OCR精度,而最强的基准为36.77%和52.31%. 其四相平面变体保留了81.84%的通过率,每幅图像的分期摊还成本不到一GPU-秒.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large text-to-image models have made rapid progress in text rendering and layout. Images often exhibit reasonable layouts and mostly correct text, yet errors persist in small text and complex characters. These errors occupy only a small part of an image but directly affect its readability and practical usability.
blocks.zh: 大型文本到图像模型在文本渲染和布局上取得了快速进展. 图像往往表现出合理的布局,并大多正确文本,然而小文本和复杂字符中的错误仍然存在. 这些错误只占据了图像的一小部分,但直接影响其可读性和实用性.

blocks.en: Further improving text accuracy within a general-purpose generative model requires balancing text fidelity against overall visual quality. For example, the pretraining experience of LongCat-Image shows that synthetic text data improves text accuracy but can impair overall visual coherence, motivating dynamic adjustment of its sampling proportion and its removal toward the end of pretraining ( Team et al., 2025 ) . Post-training for text accuracy faces a similar challenge: excessive optimization of text rewards can make text disproportionately large or prominent, compromising aesthetics and visual coherence ( Diao et al., 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026b ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Kang et al., 2026 ) . These observations motivate separating text refinement from overall image generation : preserving the layout, style, and visual content produced by the base model while precisely correcting only the erroneous text regions.
blocks.zh: 进一步提高通用分层模型中文本的准确性,需要平衡文本的忠实性和整体视觉质量。 例如,LongCat-Image的预训经验表明,合成文本数据可提高文本的准确性,但会损害整体视觉一致性,促使其抽样比例的动态调整并接近预训结束(Team等,2025年)。 文本准确性培训后面临类似挑战:过度优化文本奖励可以使文本过于庞大或突出,损害美学和视觉一致性(Diao等,2026;Team等,2026;Mao等,2026b;Jin等,2025;Chen等,2026a;Kang等,2026). 这些观察促使将文本完善与整体图像生成区分开来:保留了由基模型产生的布局,风格和视觉内容,同时精确地纠正了错误的文本区域.

blocks.en: Scene-text refinement calls for accuracy, preservation, and efficiency : correcting text faithfully, leaving unedited content unchanged, and keeping computational cost low. Existing text generation and editing methods, however, typically redraw entire text regions and can alter their original layout, style, and typeface. Most build on large latent-space generative models ( Tuo et al., 2024b ; Tuo et al., 2024a ; Lan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) , whose ability to generate and refine small text is constrained by variational autoencoder (VAE) reconstruction ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , while also incurring the cost of a large generative network and VAE encoding and decoding. Applying these methods directly to localized corrections of a few characters therefore makes it difficult to satisfy all three requirements.
blocks.zh: 改进场景文本要求准确、保存和效率:忠实地更正文本,使未经编辑的内容保持不变,使计算费用保持低廉。 然而,现有的文本生成和编辑方法通常会重新绘制整个文本区域,并可改变其原始版式、样式和排版面。 多数基于大型潜在空间基因模型(Tuo等人,2024b;Tuo等人,2024a; Lan等, 2025; Xie等, 2026),其生成和精炼出小文本的能力受变异自编码器(VAE)重建(Yu等, 2026)所制约,同时也承担了大型基因网络和VAE编码和解码的成本. 因此,将这些方法直接应用于少数字符的局部校正,很难满足所有三个要求。

blocks.en: To tackle these challenges, we introduce PixText , a text generation and refinement model based on grouped image generation in pixel space. First, we model images directly in pixel space, removing the VAE reconstruction bottleneck for small-character strokes as well as the texture degradation and color shifts introduced by local encoding and decoding. Second, we use the original image as the source that provides context and organize the regions to be refined as a group of image elements. The model predicts only the item pixels, which are then pasted back into the original image. By avoiding full-image regeneration, this design preserves unedited regions and reduces the background color drift and paste seams introduced by full-image generation. Finally, four-step MeanFlow ( Geng et al., 2026a ) reduces amortized generation cost to less than one GPU-second per image.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了PixText ,这是一个基于像素空间分组图像生成的文本生成和完善模型. 首先,我们直接用像素空间模拟图像,去除小特征中风的VAE重建瓶颈,以及由局部编码和解码引入的纹理退化和色调. 第二,我们用原始图像作为源头,提供上下文,将有待精炼的区域组织成一组图像元素. 该模型只预测物品像素,然后被粘贴回原图像. 通过避免全图像再生,这一设计保留了未经编辑的区域并减少了由全图像生成引入的背景色漂移和粘接. 最后,四步平均花(Geng等人,2026a)将分期还款的生成成本降低到每个图像不到一GPU-秒.

blocks.en: Meanwhile, we propose simple, effective training and inference improvements. We identify the influence of the training timestep distribution on patch-boundary artifacts and mitigate them with uniform sampling, observing consistent improvements in our model and MiniT2I ( Wang et al., 2026d ) . We also revise the x x -prediction sampling update to reduce speckle from incomplete denoising.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,我们提议简单、有效的培训和推论改进。 我们确定培训时间分配对补丁界限文物的影响,并用统一的取样减轻其影响,观察我们模型和MiniT2I的一致改进(Wang等,2026d)。 我们还修订了xx-预测取样更新,以减少不完全去诺的分光。

blocks.en: As a final contribution, we propose a new benchmark for text refinement. The existing AnyText Bench ( Tuo et al., 2024b ) primarily evaluates conventional text generation and lacks a dedicated evaluation of localized text errors in generated images. We therefore construct Text Refinement Bench from model-generated images, providing character-level error annotations, correction targets, and a unified evaluation protocol. The benchmark evaluates correction accuracy, background preservation, and inference efficiency. Experiments show that PixText outperforms existing baselines on text refinement and achieves performance close to or above the best existing methods on AnyText Bench at lower computational cost.
blocks.zh: 作为最后贡献,我们提出了改进案文的新基准。 现有的AnyText Beach(Tuo等,2024b)主要评价常规文本生成,缺乏对生成图像中本地化文本错误的专门评价. 因此,我们从模型生成的图像中构建了文本完善座椅,提供字符级错误说明,校正目标,以及统一的评价协议. 该基准评价校正准确性、背景保存和推论效率。 实验显示,PixText在文本改进方面超越了现有基线,并以更低的计算成本在AnyText Bench上实现了接近或高于现有最佳方法的性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Scene-Text Generation and Editing
blocks.zh: 2.1 场景文本生成和编辑

blocks.en: Early scene-text editing methods modeled content and style to replace text while preserving its appearance ( Wu et al., 2019 ; Roy et al., 2020 ; Yang et al., 2020 ; Krishnan et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2021 ; Qu et al., 2023 ) . Diffusion models improved text generation and editing through layout, glyph, and character conditioning ( Chen et al., 2023b ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Tuo et al., 2024b ; Tuo et al., 2024a ; Ji et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023a ; Zhao and Lian, 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Subsequent work advanced glyph accuracy, style control, and multilingual editing ( Zeng et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Yan et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Lan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ) , extending to open-vocabulary, training-free, and instruction-driven unified text editing ( Li et al., 2026a ; Gunawan et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Ma et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ) , as well as text correction in generated images ( Shimoda et al., 2025 ) . We focus on refining a few erroneous characters in generated images: jointly generating multiple target regions directly in pixel space avoids the effects of VAE compression and reconstruction on fine strokes while preserving unedited content. Four-step MeanFlow improves efficiency while keeping the amortized generation cost below one GPU-second per image.
blocks.zh: 早期的场景文字编辑方法建模了内容和风格,以在保留文字外观的同时取而代之(Wu等,2019;Roy等,2020;Yang等,2020;Krishnan等,2023;Lee等,2021;Qu等,2023). 传播模式通过布局、glyph和字符调节改进了文本生成和编辑(Chen等,2023b; Chen等,2024;Ma等,2023;Ma等,2025;Yang等,2023;Liu等,2024a;Liu等,2024b;Tuo等,2024b;Tuo等,2024a;Tuo等,2024a; Ji等,2023;Chen等,2023a;Zhao和Lian, 2024; 王等, 2025b.). 随后的工作推进了glyph精度,风格控制和多语种编辑(Zeng等,2024;Wang等,2025a;Yan等,2025;Fang等,2025;Lan等,2025;Xie等,2026;Chen等,2026c),延伸至开封,无培训,由教学驱动的统一文本编辑(Li等,2026a;Gunawan等,2026;Li等,2026c;Wang等,2026c;Ma等,2026a;Zhang等,2026b;Lin等,2026b;Wang等,2026a),以及生成的图像的文本校正(Shimoda等,2025a). 我们注重在生成的图像中精炼出一些错误的字符:在像素空间中共同直接生成多个目标区域,避免了VAE压缩和重建对细微中风的影响,同时保留了未经编辑的内容. 四步平均 流量提高了效率,同时将分期摊还的生成成本保持在每个图像一GPU-秒以下.

blocks.en: 2.2 Pixel-Space Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 像素-空间生成

blocks.en: Pixel-space generation models images directly, avoiding information loss from latent compression. Early work explored high-resolution modeling and computational efficiency ( Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2025 ; Jabri et al., 2022 ; Crowson et al., 2024 ; Atzmon et al., 2024 ) , while subsequent methods improved quality and efficiency through global–local modeling and frequency decomposition ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026e ; Ma et al., 2026b ; Lin et al., 2026a ) . JiT demonstrated the effectiveness of predicting clean images directly ( Li and He, 2026 ) ; related studies explored perceptual supervision, generative trajectories, and text-to-image generation and editing ( Ma et al., 2026c ; Baade et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026d ; Cai et al., 2026 ) , while transferring pretrained latent-space models reduced training costs ( Chen et al., 2026d ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Meanwhile, MeanFlow and its successors model average velocity for few-step generation, extending this approach to pixel space ( Geng et al., 2026a ; Geng et al., 2026b ; Lu et al., 2026 ) . Building on these advances, we focus on local text refinement conditioned on the original image, jointly generating the target regions to combine glyph accuracy, content preservation, and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 像素-空间生成模型图像直接,避免了潜在压缩导致的信息损失. 早期工作探索了高分辨率模型和计算效率(Hoogeboom等,2023;Hoogeboom等,2025;Jabri等,2022;Crowson等,2024;Atzmon等,2024),而随后的方法通过全球-局部模型和频率分解提高了质量和效率(Chen等,2025b;Wang等,2026b;Yu等,2026;Chen等,2026e;Ma等,2026b;Lin等,2026a). JiT证明了直接预测清洁图像(李克用和贺克用,2026年)的有效性;相关研究探索了知觉监督,基因轨迹,以及文本到图像生成和编辑(Ma等,2026c;Baade等,2026;Wang等,2026d;Cai等,2026年),同时转让训练前潜入空间模型降低了培训成本(Chen等,2026d;Chen等,2026b;Jiang等,2026年). 同时,MeanFlow及其后继者模拟了几步生成的平均速度,将这种方法扩大到像素空间(Geng等人,2026a; Geng等,2026b;Lu等,2026). 在这些进展的基础上,我们注重以原始图像为条件的本地文本的完善,共同生成目标区域,将甘油精度、内容保存和效率结合起来。

blocks.en: 3.1 Pixel-Space Generation for Quality and Efficiency
blocks.zh: 3.1 促进质量和效率的像素-空间生成

blocks.en: Latent-space text generation and editing methods rely on VAE compression and reconstruction ( Li et al., 2026a ; Chen et al., 2023b ; Zeng et al., 2024 ; Tuo et al., 2024b ; Tuo et al., 2024a ; Lan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) , which can lose fine strokes and incur additional decoding cost. Related work on autoregressive models also identifies visual-tokenizer reconstruction as a bottleneck for text detail and improves glyph quality by enhancing the decoder ( Mao et al., 2026a ) . In Figure 2 , a character approximately 20 pixels high becomes difficult to recognize after reconstruction with Stable Diffusion, FLUX.1, and Qwen-Image VAEs ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Labs et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . For edits involving only a few characters, decoding only the target region may lower VAE decoding cost, but the smaller region gives the decoder less image context. Figure 3 compares full-image and local FLUX.1-VAE decoding from the same latent representation obtained by encoding the full image: the independently decoded region exhibits a visible color mismatch when pasted back, even with 32 pixels of additional context.
blocks.zh: Lentent-space文本生成和编辑方法依赖于VAE压缩与重建(Li等,2026a; 陈等,2023b;曾等. ; Tuo等, 2024b; Tuo等, 2024a; Lan等, 2025; Xie等, 2026),可以失去细微的中风并引起额外的解码费用. 关于自递模型的相关工作还确定可视化-接接器重建为文本细节的瓶颈,并通过增强解码器来提高甘油的质量(Mao等,2026a.). 在图2中,一个大约20像素高的字符在与稳定分化、FLUX.1和Qun-Image VAEs(Rombach等,2022年;Labs等,2025年;Wu等,2025年)重建后难以识别。 对于只涉及几个字符的编辑,只有目标区域的解码可以降低VAE解码成本,但较小的区域给予解码器较少的图像上下文. 图3比较了完整图像和本地FLUX.1-VAE解码与编码完整图像时获得的同一种潜在代表值:独立解码区域在粘贴回时显示出明显的色彩不匹配,甚至有32像素的额外上下文.

blocks.en: We therefore build a flow matching model directly in pixel space, eliminating VAE encoding and decoding, and adopt the simple JiT architecture ( Li and He, 2026 ) . Table 1 shows that, under matched hardware and resolution, a single call to the JiT-L/16 output head takes less than 1% of the decoding time of the evaluated autoencoders, which also include FLUX.2 and DC-AE ( Labs, 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) . Among pixel-space models, its output head is also lighter than those of PixelDiT, DiP, and DeCo ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026e ; Ma et al., 2026b ) . These heads run at every denoising step, so their costs accumulate across sampling steps, motivating us to retain JiT’s lightweight design.

blocks.en: Recent scene-text editing methods ( Lan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) use full-image inpainting: even for local text edits, they update and decode full-image latents, reconstructing background that requires no modification. This full-image generation can shift background colors, leaving visible seams after crop-and-paste editing ( Figure 4 (a) ). The shift exceeds the VAE-only reconstruction error, showing that pasting alone does not ensure color consistency between the edited region and the original image.
blocks.zh: 近期的场景-文本编辑方法(Lan等,2025;Xie等,2026;Li等,2026a) 使用全相图印出:即使用于本地文本编辑,也会更新并解码全相图潜想,重建无需修改的背景. 这种全图像生成可以改变背景颜色,在作物和相片编辑后留下可见接缝(图4(a). 换行会超过只使用VAE的重建出错,表明单靠粘贴并不能保证被编辑区域与原始图像之间的颜色一致性.

blocks.en: We formulate text editing and refinement as grouped image generation in pixel space, separating context from generation targets. During both training and inference, we erase the existing text in each target region through local blurring before using the source image as the main-image condition. The resulting image serves as a main image providing context, while each region to be edited forms an item image . The model predicts only the item pixels and pastes them into the original. The extent of generation therefore follows the size of the edit regions, while pixels outside them are retained directly. We denote the N N clean items by x 1 = { x 1 i } i = 1 N x_{1}=\{x_{1}^{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} and their noisy counterparts by z t = { z t i } i = 1 N z_{t}=\{z_{t}^{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} . Conditioned on the main image and target glyph images, denoted by c c , the model jointly predicts x ^ 1 = f θ ​ ( z t , t , c ) \hat{x}_{1}=f_{\theta}(z_{t},t,c) .

blocks.en: We adapt JiT blocks for grouped image generation and call the resulting blocks Group JiT Blocks . These tokens are jointly processed by 32 such blocks. As illustrated in Figure 1 (c) , the main image and items interact bidirectionally, and different items attend to one another to share scene information and editing context. Cross-image attention involving each glyph is restricted to bidirectional interaction with its paired item, preserving the correspondence between text conditions and editing targets. We inject timestep conditions through adaLN-Zero ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) : noisy items receive the current timestep t t , while the main image and glyphs use the fixed clean endpoint t = 1 t=1 , distinguishing generation targets from known conditions. We use FlexAttention ( Dong et al., 2024 ) to batch variable-length image groups; implementation details are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en: Grid artifacts aligned with patch boundaries have been observed across JiT-based pixel-space models ( Wang et al., 2026d ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ) . We find that these artifacts can be mitigated by a simple change to the training timestep distribution. After initial training with logit-normal sampling, we switch to uniform sampling and continue training. Generated images and color-gradient maps in Figure 4 (b) show weaker patch-boundary discontinuities after uniform sampling; the bottom-left plot compares both training strategies from the same initialization. Uniform sampling yields lower patch-boundary gradients at both continuation checkpoints, indicating weaker grid artifacts. We further evaluate this strategy on MiniT2I-B/16. Starting from the same pretrained checkpoint used for the official logit-normal fine-tuning, we adopt uniform timestep sampling during post-training without modifying the architecture. The bottom-right plot in Figure 4 (b) shows lower boundary gradients than the official logit-normal fine-tuned model across all five inference schedules, indicating that this simple post-training adjustment also mitigates grid artifacts in another pixel-space model. Appendix F provides the experimental details.
blocks.zh: 已观察到与补丁边界一致的网格文物跨越了基于JiT的像素-空间模型(Wang等,2026d;Jiang等,2026;He等,2026). 我们发现这些文物可以通过简单的改变训练时间步分配来缓解. 经过对数正常采样的初步训练,我们改用统一的采样,继续训练. 图4(b)中生成的图像和色度图在统一取样后显示的补丁边界不连续性较弱;从下到下左的图样比较了同一初始化的两个训练策略. 在两个继续检查的检查站,统一取样产生较低的补丁分界线梯度,表明栅格文物较弱。 我们在MiniT2I-B/16上进一步评价这一战略。 从同一预先经过训练的检查站开始,用于正式的对帐正常的微调,我们在训练后采用统一的时间步抽样,而不修改结构。 图4(b)中右下方地块显示的边界梯度低于所有五个推算时间表上的官方对数正常微调模型,表明这种简单的训练后调整也减轻了另一个像素空间模型中的网格文物. 附 录 F提供了实验细节.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: AnyText Bench focuses on reconstructing annotated text at specified locations ( Tuo et al., 2024b ) , leaving a gap in open, reproducible evaluation of localized text refinement on generated images. We therefore construct Text Refinement Bench from actual model-generated images, including those released in the public Qwen-Image Bench ( Li et al., 2026b ) . Human review verifies erroneous character regions and correction targets and excludes invalid cases before freezing the evaluation list, directly reflecting the practical need to correct local errors while preserving the original image. The benchmark evaluates correction accuracy and image preservation on 1,034 images with 2,638 repair targets. We also evaluate text reconstruction on the Chinese and English subsets of AnyText Bench to assess performance on conventional visual text generation. During evaluation, we identify inaccurate text polygons and failures of the original OCR evaluation pipeline on vertically arranged text. We correct the affected text regions and adapt OCR preprocessing for vertical layouts, reducing scoring errors caused by cropping and text orientation so that evaluation better reflects the quality of the generated text.
blocks.zh: AnyText Bench专注于在特定地点重建附加说明的文本(Tuo等,2024b),在对生成的图像进行本地化文本完善的开放,可复制评价方面留下了空白. 因此,我们根据实际模型生成的图像,包括在公众Quen-Image 法官座椅上发布的图像(Li等,2026年b),构建了文本完善座椅。 人文审查核实错误的品德区和校正对象,在冻结评标清单前排除无效案件,直接反映在保留原图象的同时纠正局部错误的实际需要. 该基准评价1 034幅图像的校正准确性和图像保存情况,并有2 638个维修目标。 我们还评估AnyText Beach的中英文子集的文本重建情况,以评估传统视觉文本生成的性能。 在评价期间,我们发现文字多边形不准确,并发现在纵向排列的文字上最初OCR评价管道的失败. 我们纠正了受影响的文本区域,并调整OCR预处理的垂直布局,减少裁剪和文本取向造成的打分错误,使评价更好地反映生成文本的质量.

blocks.en: Standard OCR may transcribe a generated glyph with missing or extra strokes as the intended character, so correct recognition does not necessarily imply a successful repair. We therefore use CJK-CLIP, a dedicated CLIP-style glyph recognizer for characters, 1 1 1 The work presenting CJK-CLIP is currently under review; the model will be publicly released. to distinguish correct glyphs from visually similar but structurally incorrect outputs for character-level evaluation on Text Refinement Bench. Appendix D further describes the benchmark, its differences from related benchmarks, and the evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 标准OCR可以将所生成的格子与缺失或外出中风转换为预期字符,因此正确的识别并不一定意味着成功的修复. 因此,我们使用CJK-CLIP,一个专门的CLIP风格的字符Glyph识别器,11 1 介绍CJK-CLIP的作品目前正在审查中;该模型将公开发布. 将正确的格言与视觉上相似但结构上不正确的输出区分开来,用于文本完善座椅的字符级评价。 附 录 D进一步描述了基准、基准与相关基准的差别以及评价协议。

blocks.en: We train the model on eight H800 GPUs using an internal Chinese–English dataset containing approximately 2.53 million image records. Base-model training uses AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , zero weight decay, and an EMA decay of 0.9999. Each optimizer reinitialization starts with 2,000 linear warmup steps, followed by a constant learning rate. We follow a progressive-resolution schedule: we first train for approximately 13 epochs with at most 512 2 512^{2} pixels per main image, then increase this limit to 1024 2 1024^{2} and continue training for approximately 15 epochs. We subsequently perform approximately 3,000 MeanFlow updates with an effective batch size of 24.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个包含大约253万个图像记录的中英内部数据集,在8个H800GPU上训练模型. 基地型训练采用AdamW,学习率为10−4 10^{-4},β=(0.9,0.95)\βa=(0.9,0.95),零重量衰减,EMA衰减为0.999. 每个优化者再初始化开始有2000个线性热身步骤,之后不断学习. 我们遵循一个渐进的解析时间表:我们首先为大约13个世纪提供火车,每个主要图像最多512 2 512^{2}像素,然后将这一限制提高到1024 2 1024^{2}并继续为大约15个世纪提供培训。 我们随后进行了大约3 000个平均花的更新,有效批量尺寸为24个。

blocks.en: PixText uses patch size p = 16 p=16 , 32 Group JiT Blocks, hidden dimension 1280, and 16 attention heads. The denominator floor for velocity conversion is δ = 0.05 \delta=0.05 . Initial logit-normal timestep sampling uses μ = − 0.8 \mu=-0.8 and σ = 0.8 \sigma=0.8 , followed by uniform sampling.

blocks.en: MeanFlow uses the same optimizer settings. Both the student and frozen teacher are initialized from the base model’s EMA weights, and training intervals are formed by sorting two independently sampled uniform timesteps. The default DDE step size is h = 0.005 h=0.005 , reduced near boundaries as described above. Finite-difference predictions and subtraction use FP32 tensor arithmetic, with TF32 enabled for matrix multiplications; the trainable student forward and backward passes use BF16 mixed precision. For the main-table evaluation, PixText uses 25 Euler steps and MeanFlow uses four Euler steps, both with a glyph-conditioned classifier-free guidance (CFG) ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) scale of 3.3 (see Appendix B for details).

Finmite-difference 预测和减法使用FP32 收分数算法,TF32允许矩阵乘法;可训练的学生前向和后向通过使用BF16混合精度. 对于主表评价,PixText使用25个欧乐台阶,MeanFlow使用4个欧乐台阶,两者均以甘油为条件的无分级制导(CFG)(Ho and Salimans, 2022)为3.3分级(详见附录B).

blocks.en: Table 2 compares eight text-specialized methods with PixText and its four-step MeanFlow variant. On Text Refinement Bench, PixText achieves a Pass of 83.06%, compared with 36.77% for the strongest baseline, FLUX-Text, while also attaining the lowest FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . PP-OCRv6 gives PixText 94.66% exact target-character accuracy, compared with 52.31% for FLUX-Text.
blocks.zh: 表2比较了八种文字专用方法与PixText及其四步平面变体. 在"文字精准座"上,PixText实现了83.06%的通取率,而最强基线FLUX-Text的通取率为36.77%,同时也达到了最低的FID(Heusel等,2017年)和LPIPS(Zhang等,2018年). PP-OCRv6给出了PixText94.66%精确的目标特征,而FLUX-Text的通取率为52.31%.

blocks.en: On AnyText Bench, PixText achieves the highest Chinese text accuracy and ranks second to FLUX-Text on English, showing that its refinement advantage is accompanied by competitive text reconstruction. For each Chinese-capable baseline, we report the complete line- or character-input run with higher text accuracy; Table 4 reports both settings and all four metrics. The four-step MeanFlow variant retains the refinement advantage over the baselines while reducing generation cost relative to the base PixText model, making localized correction practical in generation workflows. Appendix I reports a comparison with Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro through its editing API on Text Refinement Bench.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: PixText refines text through localized pixel-space grouped generation, preserving fine strokes and surrounding content. It substantially improves correction on Text Refinement Bench, while its four-step MeanFlow variant costs less than one amortized GPU-second per image. Targeted pixel-space generation thus improves text readability while preserving image appearance.
blocks.zh: PixText通过本地化的像素-空间分组生成来完善文本,保存精细的中风和周围的内容. 它大大地改进了文本精准座的校正,而它的四步平面变体成本低于每个图像一个分期摊还的GPU-秒. 因此,目标像素-空间生成提高了文本可读性,同时保留了图像外观.

blocks.en: Appendix A Variable-Length Batch Training with FlexAttention
blocks.zh: 附录A 带有弹性标记的可变 Length 批次培训

blocks.en: The main-image resolution, number of edit regions, and region sizes vary across samples, giving each image group a different number of tokens. We concatenate the main-image, item-image, and glyph tokens from all groups along the sequence dimension to form a batch, without padding each group to a common length. Each token retains its group membership and spatial position within the group, allowing samples with different image sizes and numbers of regions to be trained together.
blocks.zh: 主图像解析度,编辑区域数,以及区域大小因样本不同而不同,使每个图像组都有不同的符号. 我们从序列维度上将主图像、项目图像和格莱弗符号 组合成一个批次,而不将每个组编成一个共同长度。 每个标志都保留其组团成员和在组团内的空间位置,使图像大小和地区数目不同的样本能够一起接受训练.

blocks.en: The attention mask controls both isolation between groups and interaction within each group. Attention between different groups is fully masked. Within a group, the main image and items interact bidirectionally, items attend to one another, and each glyph interacts across images only with its paired item; self-attention within each image is retained. Sequence concatenation therefore changes how the batch is organized while preserving the information flow within each sample.
blocks.zh: 注意力掩盖了各群体之间的隔离和每个群体内部的互动。 不同群体之间的注意力被完全掩盖。 在一个组内,主要图像和项目双向交互,项目互相关注,每个glyph只与其配对的项目交互;每个图像内部的自意保留. 因此,序列组合会改变批次的组织方式,同时保留每个样本内的信息流动。

blocks.en: We encode these rules as a FlexAttention block-sparse mask and reuse it across Transformer layers. FlexAttention skips fully masked attention blocks and applies the specified masking within the remaining blocks, without explicitly storing a dense attention matrix for the entire concatenated sequence. Combining variable-length sequence packing with masked attention avoids the computation introduced by padding to the longest sample, while preserving joint modeling within groups and independence between groups.
blocks.zh: 我们把这些规则编码为 FlexAttenty 块-sparse 面具,并跨变形器层重用. FlexAttenty跳过被完全遮住的注意力块,并在所剩的块内应用指定的遮住,而没有明确为整个被遮住的序列存储密集的注意力矩阵. 将可变长序列包装与被蒙蔽的注意力相组合,避免了通过粘贴到最长的样本所引入的计算,同时保留了组内的联合模型和组间的独立性.

blocks.en: We train the two classifier-free guidance (CFG) branches by randomly dropping glyph conditions. For each training image group, we remove all glyph tokens associated with its items with probability 0.1; otherwise, all glyph conditions are retained. Dropping a condition removes the glyph branch from the input sequence. The main image, noisy items, and region geometry remain available, so “unconditional” here refers only to the absence of target glyphs; scene context is still provided. Random condition dropout is disabled during validation and inference, when predictions with and without glyph conditions are constructed explicitly.

blocks.en: Appendix D Text Refinement Bench and Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 附录D 改进法官职位和评价设置

blocks.en: Text Refinement Bench targets local character errors in generated images, complementing text-generation benchmarks such as AnyText ( Tuo et al., 2024b ) and instruction-driven editing benchmarks such as TextEdit, TextEditBench, and MultiTextEdit ( Tian et al., 2026 ; Gui et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) . Explicit repair regions and target characters focus evaluation on correction quality and image preservation, reducing dependence on instruction interpretation and target localization. ScenePair ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) also provides region-level pairs, but its source text and target reference come from the same image. Although its original crop-based protocol does not expose the reference, directly supplying the full image as context would reveal it; evaluating context-aware refinement therefore requires adapting this setup. Our benchmark is built around repairing actual generation errors with the surrounding image as context, and jointly measures target-glyph agreement, character identification, and image preservation.
blocks.zh: 文本改进 座椅针对生成图像的本地字符错误,补充了AnyText(Tuo等,2024b)等文本生成基准,以及TextEdit,TextEdit Bench,和MultiTextEdit等指令驱动编辑基准(Tian等,2026;Gui等,2025;Cheng等,2026). 明确修复区域和目标人物注重校正质量和图像保存评价,减少对指令解读的依赖并有针对性地定位. ScenePair(Zeng等,2024年)也提供地区级对等,但其出处出自同一图像的出处为出处的出处为出处为出处为出处. 虽然其原有的以作物为基础的协议没有披露该参考,但直接提供完整的图像,因为上下文会揭示它;因此,评价对上下文的认识的改进需要调整这一设置。 我们的基准是围绕修复实际生成错误,将周围的图像作为上下文,并共同衡量目标-格氏协议、字符识别和图像保存。

blocks.en: The reviewed benchmark contains 1,034 images and 2,638 repair targets. All methods use all 2,638 repair targets for character-level metrics, and FID and LPIPS cover the same 1,034 images.
blocks.zh: 经审查的基准包括1 034个图像和2 638个修理目标。 所有方法都使用所有2,638个字符级度量衡的修复目标,FID和LPIPS覆盖相同的1,034个图像.

blocks.en: We use CJK-CLIP to measure similarity between a character image and its intended character, evaluating glyph correctness beyond whether the image can be recognized as the target.
blocks.zh: 我们使用CJK-CLIP来测量一个字符图像与它预定的字符的相似性,评价格莱弗正确性,超出图像是否可以被识别为目标.

blocks.en: All methods are evaluated with the same CJK-CLIP model and character-specific pass thresholds. Let S ⁡ ( I , y ) S(I,y) denote the similarity between character image I I and target y y , and let μ y \mu_{y} be its mean over reference images of that character. A repaired glyph passes when pass ( I , y ) = [ S ( I , y ) ≥ μ y − 0.03 ] . \operatorname{pass}(I,y)=\mathbb{1}\!\left[S(I,y)\geq\mu_{y}-0.03\right]. (12) Pass is the fraction of target characters satisfying this criterion; R@1 is the fraction for which the target ranks first by similarity over the character vocabulary. They measure target-glyph agreement and character identification, respectively. A malformed glyph can still be closest to the intended character, explaining why R@1 can exceed Pass. AnyText Bench retains its OCR-based evaluation.
blocks.zh: 所有方法都采用相同的CJK-CLIP模型和特异性通过阈值来评价. 让 S (I, y) S (I, y) 表示角色图像 I 与目标 y y 的相似性, 让 μ y\ mu_{y 成为它相对于该角色的参考图像的恶性. 已修复的格莱弗通过时( I, y) = [S( I, y) = μ y – 0.03].\ 操作名{ pass} (I, y)\ mathb{ 1}\!\ 左 [S( I, y)\ geq\ mu_{y}- 0.03\ 右]. (12) Pass是符合这个标准的目标字符的分数;R@1是目标在字符词汇上以相近性排行第一的分数. 它们分别衡量目标-格氏协议和特征识别. 一个畸形的glyph仍然可以最接近预定字符,解释为什么R@1可以超过Pass. 任何法庭都保留其基于OCR的评价。

blocks.en: We additionally evaluate the same 2,638 target characters with the PP-OCRv6 medium recognizer. 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv6_medium_rec OCR Acc is the percentage whose transcription exactly matches the repair target; blank or multi-character outputs count as errors. OCR Acc measures recognizability, whereas Pass additionally tests glyph fidelity.
blocks.zh: 我们还用 PP-OCRv6 中识别器对同样的2,638个目标字符进行了评价。 2 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv6_medical_rec OCR (英语). Acc 是指抄录与修复目标完全匹配的百分比;空白或多字符输出算作出错. OCR Acc测量可识别性,而通过额外测试甘油的忠诚性。

blocks.en: Figure 7 illustrates stroke errors missed by high-confidence OCR recognition. All four glyphs are transcribed as their targets with confidence between 99.67% and 99.97%, yet fail the CJK-CLIP criterion, consistent with the human error annotations.
blocks.zh: 图7显示高自信OCR识别误入中风. 所有4个glyphs都以99.67%到99.97%的置信度被转录为目标,然而却未能达到CJK-CLIP标准,符合人的错误说明.

OCR confidently transcribes these malformed glyphs as the targets above, CJK-CLIP similarity scores fall below their respective acceptance thresholds μ y − 0.03 \mu_{y}-0.03 , yielding Error decisions consistent with human annotations.

blocks.en: Pass, R@1, and OCR Acc on Text Refinement Bench, and sentence accuracy (Acc) on AnyText, are reported as percentages. LPIPS uses AlexNet on full images resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 . Chinese AnyText OCR scores use a common set of vertical text boxes and symbol-width equivalence rules.
blocks.zh: 文本改进座椅上的通行证、R@1和OCR Acc,以及任何文本的句子准确度按百分比报告。 LPIPS在全图像上使用AlexNet被调整为256×256256\times 256. 中国AnyText OCR分数使用一套常见的垂直文本框和符号-width等同规则.

blocks.en: Some original polygons do not accurately cover the text, so direct cropping can truncate glyphs or include neighboring content. We review the character boxes and use the corrected regions for vertically arranged Chinese text. Characters are cropped in top-to-bottom reading order, kept upright, and concatenated horizontally before OCR, avoiding recognition errors caused by rotating the entire vertical line. All compared Chinese methods use the same reviewed annotations and recognition preprocessing; horizontal text retains the original line-level crops.
blocks.zh: 一些原多边形没有准确覆盖文字,因此直接裁剪可以截取格子或包括相邻内容. 我们检讨字符框,使用校正区域进行垂直排列的中文文字. 字符被裁剪为从上到下取取读顺序,保持向上,并水平地缩放在OCR之前,避免了由旋转整个垂直线所引发的识别错误. 所有比较的中国方法都使用相同的经审查的说明和识别预处理;横向文本保留了原来的行级收成.

blocks.en: For AnyText ZH, we evaluate the four Chinese-capable baselines with both the official line polygons and the character regions supplied to PixText. For each method, the main table reports the complete run with higher sentence accuracy: character input for AnyText and line input for AnyText2, FLUX-Text, and TextFlux. NED, FID, and LPIPS come from that same run. TextDiffuser, TextCtrl, UDiffText and DiffSTE do not support Chinese target conditioning in the evaluated official checkpoints. We therefore report their AnyText English results on all 1,000 images and 4,181 lines, and mark AnyText ZH and the Chinese-containing Text Refinement Bench as unsupported. UDiffText uses crop-based editing with polygon-restricted compositing; DiffSTE uses a 256-pixel working canvas and sequential target editing. Dashes indicate unsupported settings.
blocks.zh: 对于AnyText ZH,我们用官方的行多边形和提供给PixText的字符区域来评价四个中能基线. 对于每种方法,主表格以更高的句子精度报告完整运行:AnyText的字符输入和AnyText2,FLUX-Text的行输入和TextFlux. NED,FID,和LPIPS来自同一跑道. TextDiffuser,TextCtrl,UDiffText和DiffSTE不支持被评价的官方检查站的中国目标配置. 因此,我们将所有1 000个图像和4 181行的AnyText英文结果报告,并标出AnyText ZH和含有中文的 " 文字精选 " 。 UDiffText使用以作物为主的编辑,并有多边形限制的堆肥;DiffSTE使用256像素工作帆布并相继进行目标编辑. Dashes 表示不支持的设置 。

The input with higher sentence accuracy (Acc) is marked ⋆ \star and supplies all four metrics in the main table; metrics are never selected independently.

blocks.en: Table 4 shows that all four Chinese-capable baselines can use character-level targets. AnyText improves from 65.87% to 66.54% Acc with character input; the other three baselines achieve higher Acc with their line inputs. Reporting the stronger setting for each method preserves its complete text and image metrics while making the input choice explicit.
blocks.zh: 表4显示,所有4个中能基线都可以使用字符级目标. AnyText的字符输入率从65.87%提高到66.54%;而其他三个基线则通过他们的行输入实现更高的Acc. 报告每种方法的较强设置可以保留其完整的文字和图像衡量标准,同时明确输入选择。

blocks.en: GPU-s/img is the summed GPU generation time divided by the number of images. Batch sizes are chosen to keep GPU compute units fully occupied throughout generation. Parameter counts include the generation network, VAE, and text encoders. Generation networks include control branches and unmerged adapters.

blocks.en: On one NVIDIA H800, we time batch-one requests for 32 evenly spaced images from Text Refinement Bench, with two warm-up runs per implementation and three measurements per image. PixText + MeanFlow averages 1.152 s per request; batching the conditional and unconditional CFG branches reduces this to 1.062 s (7.8% faster). Even with one image per request, PixText + MeanFlow remains faster than all compared baselines, whose lowest amortized cost is 3.126 GPU-s/img.
blocks.zh: 在一个NVIDIA H800上,我们按时间批次要求从文本精准座获得32个平分相距的图像,每个执行两次热身运行,每个图像三次测量。 PixText + MeanFlow 平均每个请求为 1.152 s;分批附加条件和无条件的 CFG 分支,将它降低到 1.062 s (7.8%快). 即使每个请求有一个图像,PixText + MeanFlow仍然比所有基准都快,其最低摊还成本为3.126 GPU-s/img.

blocks.en: CCPE allows item crops to start independently of the main-image patch grid; only their width and height must be multiples of the patch size. blocks.en: We compare the two crop choices on 116,038 text regions from 5,000 images randomly sampled from our training dataset, using a patch size of 16 pixels. Grid alignment requires 2,923,250 item tokens, whereas CCPE requires 2,523,979, a reduction of 13.7% . Both cover the same target text; the savings come from tighter crops.

blocks.en: Although PixText is trained primarily on Chinese and English data, glyph conditions directly describe the visual shapes of target characters, providing a natural representation for specifying other characters. In the examples shown in Figure 16 , the model follows the supplied glyphs to generate the target content while retaining adjacent text and background. These qualitative results suggest the potential of glyph conditioning for generation beyond the main training scripts.

blocks.en: Appendix I Comparison with Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro
blocks.zh: 附录一 与Quen-Image-3.0-Pro的比较

blocks.en: We compare PixText and PixText + MeanFlow with Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro on the same 1,034-image Text Refinement Bench used in the main results. The API receives each full image and all its repair targets in one bounding-box text prompt. It returns 1,027 edited images and refuses to generate edited outputs for the remaining seven inputs; their 11 repair targets count as failures in the text-accuracy metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了PixText和PixText + MeanFlow 与 Quen-Image-3.0-Pro 在主结果中使用的相同的 1 034-图像文本完善座椅. API接收到每个完整的图像及其所有修复目标在一个有边框的文本提示中. 它返回了1,027个经过编辑的图像,并拒绝为其余7个输入生成经过编辑的产出;它们的11个修复目标算作文本精确度指标中的故障.

blocks.en: Both PixText variants achieve substantially higher text accuracy and better image preservation than the API. This shows that even an advanced image-editing model can remain unreliable for precise, localized text repair.
blocks.zh: PixText的两种变体都实现了比API高得多的文本精度和更好的图像保存. 这表明,即使是先进的图像编辑模型,对于精确,局部的文本修复来说也可能仍然是不可靠的.
